purpose: Stands for the collapsed start of a long Breadcrumb trail and opens a menu of the hidden segments. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Breadcrumb.
A generic overflow menu of commands.
A gap marker between page numbers.

Default.visual: default: label Content/secondary. ghost has no fill; outline adds a Border/control stroke; solid fills Surface/muted.

Hover.visual: default: label Content/accent (outline stroke Border/accent, solid fill Surface/accent). secondary: label Content/primary (outline stroke Border/control-hover, solid fill Surface/muted-hover).

Focused.visual: default: Border/focus stroke with a Border/ring/default halo. secondary: Border/strong stroke with a Border/subtle halo. Label stays Content/secondary.

Disabled.visual: Label Content/disabled; outline stroke Border/subtle, solid fill Action/disabled/default.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space activates it.

openQuestions: Which component shows the hidden segments (a DropdownMenu?), and is it wired inside BreadcrumbEllipsis or left to the app?
Motion: the State axis has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry (finding MOT-002). Should hover and focus animate?
